bundle.shortDescription: Consent-first messaging for SMS, WhatsApp & Email: double opt-in, proof logged, STOP honoured instantly.
bundle.longDescription: Opt-In Message is a free, open-source, consent-first messaging app for SMS, WhatsApp and Email. Contacts must complete double opt-in before they can receive anything, campaigns cannot send until a human approves them, and anyone who replies STOP is excluded from every future send — automatically. The desktop app wraps the zero-dependency Python engine (bundled as resources) and launches it locally on your own machine; bring your own provider keys (Twilio / Meta / SMTP). Includes the Meta AI Studio (draft, translate, compliance-check), shared inbox, analytics and a PWA. Free and open source (MIT).
